semantics.bridgeTraces: A workflow trace mutation must preserve every bridge request witness already collected by the V2 runtime.
semantics.variableMutation: Updating variableChanges must not clear bridgeTraces.
semantics.outputMutation: Updating outputSummary must not clear bridgeTraces.
semantics.errorMutation: Protected-response, rule-failure and workflow-exception rewrites must retain bridgeTraces.
